mapper.select: SELECT message_id,user_id,parent_id,status,is_secret,create_time FROM blog_message ORDER BY create_time,message_id
SELECT FROM blog_message m JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=m.user_id WHERE m.message_id IN #{id} ORDER BY m.create_time,m.message_id
SELECT FROM blog_message m JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=m.user_id WHERE m.message_id=#{id} AND m.user_id=#{user}
SELECT * FROM blog_message WHERE message_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_message SET content=#{row.content},content_format=#{row.contentFormat},notify_reply=#{row.notifyReply},status=#{row.status},edited_at=#{row.editedAt} WHERE message_id=#{row.messageId} AND user_id=#{user}
